lines.zh: 我踩着湿泥一步步踏进来
lines.en: I tread in step by step through wet mud
The tide rises in my footprints
My thick hide scrapes the tree trunks
My tusks hang very low
I can smell thirty blocks out
I push whole shrubs aside
My four hooves press deep pits

lines.zh: 海水从我的皮缝里渗出
lines.en: Seawater seeps from my hide

lines.zh: 我走得不快，但没人挡得住
lines.en: I walk slowly, but nothing stops me
I patrol the forest edge
A salt smell spreads in the air
My hooves crush shells underfoot

lines.zh: 我从林间空地横穿而过
lines.en: I cut across the forest clearing
Water streams off me the whole way

lines.zh: 我朝内陆走得更深一点
lines.en: I push a little deeper inland

lines.zh: 我的影子在泥上拖得很长
lines.en: My shadow drags long across the mud
I stand with my tusks toward this way
Seaweed still drips from my hide
My breath carries a tidal smell
I listen to the sounds in the woods

lines.zh: 我的皮下面是新的组织
lines.en: Under my hide is new tissue
I am slowly growing, slowly getting stronger

lines.zh: 珊瑚刺从我的背上探出
lines.en: Coral spines push out of my back
I stay motionless like a reef rock

lines.zh: 海嗣的血在我身体里流
lines.en: Seaborn blood flows in me
I wait for the next high tide
I root my snout into the mud

lines.zh: 我身上的藤壶发出细响
lines.en: The barnacles on me click softly
Muddy water drips from my chin
I lift my eyelids, not my head
Your scent is very dry
Everything on land is so small
You are standing on my mudflat

lines.zh: 我的獠牙比你的手臂长
lines.en: My tusks are longer than your arm

lines.zh: 你不该站在我的潮线上
lines.en: You should not stand on my tideline
I grow day by day

lines.zh: 你看起来不像是能挡我
lines.en: You do not look like you can stop me
My nose twitched once

lines.zh: 这具身体不是海里的了
lines.en: This body is no longer a sea one

lines.zh: 你想让我退回去，我偏不
lines.en: You want me back in the water, I refuse
A gash opens in my hide
This wound only makes me fiercer
The blood I spill is salt.
One hit taken, one returned
A film of new tissue rises in the wound

lines.zh: 我把头转向伤我的方向
lines.en: I turn my head toward what hurt me
Two coral spines broke
My breathing is heavier

lines.zh: 这点痛让我的身体更紧
lines.en: The pain tightens my body

lines.zh: 我退了一步，不会再退第二步
lines.en: I take one step back, and no second
That is the smell of raw meat

lines.zh: 海嗣早就越过了这层需要
lines.en: The Seaborn are past such needs
What I smell is something else

lines.zh: 你手里那点不够我塞牙
lines.en: What you hold would not fill one tooth
The tide has thinned the smell

lines.zh: 你举着它站在我的路上
lines.en: You stand in my path holding it up
I do not bow my head for food

lines.zh: 这点分量，引不动我的蹄。
lines.en: That much won't move these hooves.
I take half a step toward it
Your hand shook, I saw it

lines.zh: 你撞在我身上，像撞堤岸
lines.en: You hit me like hitting a seawall
My feet didn't move. You did.
Under my hide is all hard mass
You charge in and slide off on your own.

lines.zh: 我们擦身而过时你听见了响
lines.en: You heard it when we passed

lines.zh: 我的獠牙离你的脸很近
lines.en: My tusk came close to your face
That bump is a scratch to me
Step away and I keep walking
My breath sprays over you
You cannot stop my weight
My kind are out in the tide
Such things happen in deep water

lines.zh: 我身上的组织会自己增殖
lines.en: My tissue multiplies on its own
Propagation needs no part from you

lines.zh: 我背上的珊瑚会再长一层
lines.en: The coral on my back will grow another layer
You need not understand this

lines.zh: 海嗣的延续比你想的更冷
lines.en: Seaborn continuity is colder than you think
I turn my head to look at the sea
Leave these things to the tide
I go on patrolling the wood

lines.zh: 我低下头把东西拱起来
lines.en: I lower my head and root it up
I will keep this meat
I flip it with my snout
What lies in the mud is mine
I bite it and drag it two steps
Not enough, but it counts
I trample it into the mud

lines.zh: 地上散的东西我都扫过来
lines.en: I sweep up whatever is scattered
I sniff it and swallow
The tide will collect what's left for me.
You are that smell from before
I have you locked within thirty blocks
I start pressing toward you
One hit and I always answer

lines.zh: 这片林子现在是我的猎场
lines.en: This wood is my hunting ground now
My forebody has risen
I'm going to fight. No reasons needed.

lines.zh: 你站在我推进的方向上
lines.en: You stand in the direction I advance
My tusks are aimed at your middle

lines.zh: 潮声盖住了你后退的脚步声
lines.en: The tide covers your retreating steps
I bear down step by step
You're retreating too slowly. I hear it.
The coral on me is moving

lines.zh: 你身上没有海嗣的味道
lines.en: You carry no Seaborn scent
I knock down two trees
My breathing grows coarser
You are hiding behind a tree
I do not need to see you clearly

lines.zh: 潮水还在涨，你没有退路
lines.en: The tide is still rising, you have no way out
I press a little nearer

lines.zh: 我的头一甩，獠牙扫过去
lines.en: I swing my head and my tusks sweep across
This one is sixteen damage
I butt you off the ground
My forehoof comes down
I push the whole thicket aside
My shoulder rams your chest

lines.zh: 海水这时正好漫到你膝上
lines.en: The seawater reaches your knees just then
My mouth is full of foam
This blow carries my whole weight

lines.zh: 我的獠牙挑起它的侧腹
lines.en: My tusks scoop up its flank
I walk up out of the tideline

lines.zh: 林间的空气第一次这么干
lines.en: The air in the wood is so dry at first
Seaweed still hangs from my hide

lines.zh: 二百一十八点生命，够我站住
lines.en: Two hundred eighteen health is enough to hold

lines.zh: 海嗣开始往陆地推进了
lines.en: The Seaborn have begun pushing inland
My tusks push out of the shrubs first
This wood will be eaten bare
I shake off a coat of seawater

lines.zh: 我是被召来的，不是偶然
lines.en: I was summoned, not by chance

lines.zh: 我踩着浪的边缘往上走
lines.en: I walk up along the edge of the waves

lines.zh: 火焰烤着我的皮下脂肪
lines.en: Fire roasts the fat under my hide
I fell into the mud and splashed wide

lines.zh: 海水对我来说不该是负担
lines.en: Seawater should not be a burden to me
The blast split my thick hide

lines.zh: 飞来的东西扎进我的肩
lines.en: Something flying lodged in my shoulder

lines.zh: 那股术力在我体内乱窜
lines.en: That magic races through my body

lines.zh: 我还没进食，组织在消耗
lines.en: I have not fed, my tissue is being consumed
Lightning struck the coral on my back
All the mud beneath me is gone
